title: Moving Mannequins
description: A datapack which uses glazed terracotta to command mannequins to move
body:
Use Glazed Terracotta to move mannequins around! The mannequin will jump over most solid blocks.
**This pack does not allow for spawning of said mannequins nor customization**

# Blocks
- Magenta Glazed Terracotta: Sets the direction the mannequin is moving
- Red Glazed Terracotta: Stops the mannequin
- Yellow Glazed Terracotta: Moves the mannequin at crouching speed
- Green Glazed Terracotta: Moves the mannequin at walking speed
- Light Blue Glazed Terracotta: Moves the mannequin at sprinting speed.
